verified_bug: The historical MO-CAPO-style initializer passed a zero-shot downstream_template to Prompt with nonempty few_shots, causing those demonstrations to be omitted. v9.4 overrides an explicit construction hook using rendered_prompt. Historical v9.2/v9.3 keep the old behavior for reproducibility.
verification_gap: The old generic preflight tested the rendering helper but not the actual optimizer initializer. New preflight invokes the real override and regression tests exercise the complete initializer.
tri_fair_changes: bounded complete-instruction generation and novelty retries
one complete demo-unit removal in compression
delete-one-block stable ordering before early rejection
structure_retained: partial rejected candidates retained as genetic material
explicit_departures_from_MOCAPO: scoped evidence variation instead of exclusively CAPO crossover/mutation
early rejection stability heuristic; no confidence guarantee
baseline_policy: All four plain baseline implementations, selectors, shared frozen seed instructions, demonstration pool, labels, datasets and mathematical fairness metrics remain unchanged. No intentional degradation.

budget_policy.difference_from_v93: 80/20 allocation replaces 70/30 for all methods; do not pool old v9.3 screen and new baseline results as one matched experiment.

figures.method_colors: MO-CAPO analysis palette: black, orange #E69F00, purple #785EF0, green #009E73, pink #CC79A7
figures.fewshot_count: actually rendered demonstrations; both stored and hidden counts exported
figures.front_indicators: terminal audited shortlist only; not the entire search history
figures.uncertainty: sample SD across seeds only; no bands with one seed; no significance claim

risk: More conservative rejection can spend more evaluation tokens per challenger. Accurate demonstration rendering can also raise initialization cost. A measured GPU pilot is required to assess the trade-off.
outputs: All sources, scalar objectives, fairness components, attempt logs and checkpoints are preserved; no measured results overwritten.

verified_saved_artifact_evidence.point: These are omitted demonstrations, not evidence of data leakage or falsified outputs.
